title: Return early, then use the pattern variable

blocks.text: A pattern variable is in scope wherever the match is certain. After a negated test that leaves the method, that is the whole rest of the method:
Write `of(Object obj)` in `Initial`. It returns the first character of a String, in upper case, and `'?'` when there is no initial to give:

items: `of("")` is `'?'`: an empty String has no first character;

origin.section: Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them

concepts: After if (!(obj instanceof String s)) return;, the pattern variable is in scope for the rest of the method.
